Requirement: Shielding (Novice)

Cost: 1+ PP

Time: Free action

Target Number: Target Force

Test: See description

You can use your psychic ability to counteract the abilities of others before they take effect. When someone within your line of sight uses a psychic discipline, you can make a power test against the power test of the target psychic and spend PP equal to the cost of the discipline they are using. If you win the test, your foe’s power test for the psychic discipline is considered to have failed, although they have still spent the PP for it. If they win the test, the discipline works normally. If you do not have sufficient PP to block a particular discipline’s use, then the effort automatically fails and you cannot counter your foe’s power.
